scope: Read-only P0 audit of the Q3D spec against the frozen A-3D baseline. This is not the final review: worker code was not reviewed, nothing was executed on patient data, and no GPU was used.

mednext_stride8_decoder.module: model.dec_block_3 (nn.Sequential of MedNeXtBlock). It is the first decoder block after the bottleneck, and its input is x_res_3 + up_3(bottleneck)
mednext_stride8_decoder.C_T: 256 when MedNeXt-L n_channels=32. It equals adapter.channels[3] = down_2.conv3.out_channels, the same width as x_res_3
mednext_stride8_decoder.adapter_channels: (stem.out, down_0, down_1, down_2, down_3 conv3.out) = (32, 64, 128, 256, 512), expected for L k3. Must be checked at runtime by P0 once a checkout exists
mednext_stride8_decoder.not_exposed: _native_forward_with_features returns features=(x_res_0..x_res_3, bottleneck) and the logits only (self_audit/candidate_a3d/teacher.py:326,335). The output of dec_block_3 is never returned
mednext_stride8_decoder.hook_caveat: The L factory enables outside_block checkpointing. apply_block(sequential=True) then calls model.iterative_checkpoint, which loops over the children of dec_block_3 (self_audit/candidate_a3d/teacher.py:309-313), so dec_block_3.forward never runs and a forward hook registered on dec_block_3 never fires. Register the hook on dec_block_3[-1] instead, or on dec_block_3 only after checking that outside_block_checkpointing is False. In grad-enabled Stage T, checkpoint recompute fires the hook a second time; frozen no_grad Stages Q/P/J fire it once.
mednext_stride8_decoder.alternative_ablation_sources: The stride-16 bottleneck is features[4]. The stride-4 option is dec_block_2 (C=128), with the same hook caveat

teacher_padding.fact: padding_multiple = 2**(len(channels)-1) = 16. The minimum size per axis is 32 for MedNeXt. Padding is replicate at the end of every axis, and outputs are cropped. Spec line 66 matches this.

evidence: self_audit/candidate_a3d/teacher.py:780 teacher_loss uses one masked MAE over all voxels and channels
git grep found no near/far weighting on any branch
near_far_sdf.available: The SDF target exists: QueryBank3D.sdf_targets (self_audit/candidate_a3d/bank.py:403-437). It uses continuous voxel-face distance with anisotropic spacing_zyx, is divided by radius_mm (5.0) and clamped to [-1,1], gives +1 for an absent class and -1 for a class that fills the volume, and has 4 channels including BG. The teacher sdf head is tanh (self_audit/candidate_a3d/teacher.py:540).

blockers.issue: The spec says the teacher starts from 'the pretrained MedNeXt checkpoint used by the current k=2 run'. No such checkpoint exists: every committed A-3D config has weights=null, and no official public v1 L k3 weights were found. In addition, _load_mednext accepts only a provenance payload with TRAIN labeled_ids/unlabeled_ids/data_sha256 and a strict 4-class out_0. Raw public weights would be rejected, and weights=null silently yields UNTRAINED_RANDOM_INIT.
blockers.correction: Config/engine owners: a real Stage T must fail closed unless weights_status is a verified pretrained status. weights=null must be an error for non-synthetic runs, with no random-init fallback. If verified external weights appear, add a separate q3d loader inside candidate_q3d (do not edit teacher.py). It should do a strict key/shape inventory of encoder and decoder, re-initialize out_0 to 4 classes, and record pretraining_data, the overlap with ACDC/M&Ms, and the sha256. Until then, T/Q/J real gates are SOFTWARE_ONLY.

blockers.issue: The spec says to take the stride-8 decoder feature 'via _native_forward_with_features, without a second forward', but that method does not return the decoder feature. A naive forward hook on dec_block_3 is silently skipped under outside_block checkpointing (see hook_caveat).
blockers.correction: teacher_features.py owner (tokenizer worker): capture the output of dec_block_3[-1] with a hook registered for the duration of the single fused teacher forward. Assert that exactly one capture happens per no_grad forward, that its shape is [B,256,D_p/8,H_p/8,W_p/8], and that C_T == adapter.channels[3]; otherwise fail closed. Add a test with outside_block_checkpointing=True on a stub that mimics iterative_checkpoint.

blockers.issue: The near/far balanced SDF loss is not on main or on any branch. The spec fallback ('merge it first in P1') cannot be met, and candidate_a3d is frozen, so teacher_loss cannot be patched.
blockers.correction: Engine/losses owner: implement q3d_teacher_loss in candidate_q3d/losses.py. Keep the CE+Dice terms via self_audit.losses.supervised_loss and reuse bank.sdf_targets (R=5 mm). near = |target| < 0.5, i.e. |d| < 2.5 mm, judged on the GT-derived target, never on the prediction. Use L1, take the near mean and the far mean pooled over all 4 channels per sample, and combine as 0.5*near + 0.5*far. If one set is empty, use weight 1 on the other set. Absent classes (+1) fall in far. Reuse the same function for student S2. Unit test on hand-made volumes.

major_issues.issue: Alignment convention. The spec puts the cell centers at box centers: teacher 8k+3.5, student 16j+7.5. The real strided convolutions put them elsewhere. A MedNeXt down block (k3, pad k//2, stride 2, plus a 1x1 stride-2 residual) centers cell k at native voxel 8k. The spec's student down conv k(1,3,3) stride (1,2,2) pad 1 centers cell j at 16j. MedNeXt up blocks also pad (1,0) after a transposed conv, which places bottleneck cell i at stride-8 index 2i+1, i.e. a +8 voxel shift of the upsampled path inside dec_block_3 (upstream source as remembered; verify). The z formula (z+0.5)/8-0.5 equals (z-3.5)/8, while the conv-center convention gives z/8. That is a 0.44-cell (3.5-slice, about 35 mm) disagreement when D is about 10. In-plane the error is 4-7.5 px, which is sub-cell.
major_issues.correction: Alignment owner: implement align_teacher_to_student4 with declared center offsets. Teacher cell center c_T(k) = 8k + o_T. Student cell center c_S = (z, 16j+o_S, 16i+o_S). Sample the teacher at coordinate (c_S - o_T)/8 with separable linear interpolation on all three axes, clamped to the valid cells [0, ceil(n_native/8)-1]. The spec's 2x2 average and its z formula are exactly the case o_T=3.5, o_S=7.5, so the spec's unit tests still apply with the box offsets. Recommended defaults are o_T=0 and o_S matched to the student's real downsampling. Add a P0/P2 SOFTWARE_ONLY diagnostic that measures o_T empirically per axis from the gradient centroid of a dec_block_3[-1] cell with respect to the input; this is architecture geometry and needs no weights. Apply the same box-versus-center convention to cls_T4, w_cell and the Q3 class fractions, so all stage-4 targets refer to the same cells.

major_issues.issue: Padding invariance ('changing values in the pad region does not change outputs in the valid region') cannot be satisfied if the student convolves and normalizes a padded canvas whose pad content is free. k3 convs, trilinear upsampling and InstanceNorm statistics all read the pad.
major_issues.correction: Student owner, independent interpretation. Minimum gate: the model takes a native-size input (or a canvas plus valid_shape), crops to the valid region, and re-derives the pad by replicating from the valid voxels at entry. Then (a) the output shape equals the native shape for odd H/W and D in {6,9,10,13,20}, and (b) noise written into the canvas pad leaves the valid-region output bitwise identical. Stronger, recommended gate: masked InstanceNorm and masked EPA pooling over valid tokens only, plus re-replicating pads from the per-stage valid extent ceil(H/2^s) after every block. Then (c) padding to a multiple of 16 versus 32 gives the same valid output within 1e-5 in fp32. EPA pooling grid should be (min(D,4), min(h,4), min(w,4)) so small synthetic fixtures do not produce empty bins.

major_issues.issue: The spec selects teacher and student checkpoints by DEV FG Dice. HEAD METHOD.md and the HEAD AGENTS.md say development masks 'never choose a checkpoint or stop training'. The working-tree AGENTS.md rewritten by the integration worker drops that clause.
major_issues.correction: Coordinator/user decision. Either keep DEV read-only and use the final checkpoint of the fixed schedule (or a TRAIN-only criterion), or explicitly authorize DEV selection and record it as a protocol deviation from the A-3D baselines, which never select on DEV. Do not mix the two policies across arms.

major_issues.issue: A concurrent worker deleted all 35 baseline test files and 15 documents (about 6.2k lines) and limited pytest to test_q3d*. The spec and the new AGENTS keep A/A-3D as frozen baselines that Q3D imports (teacher, bank.sdf_targets, data, semisupervised.strong_intensity), so baseline regression coverage is lost.
major_issues.correction: Integration owner and coordinator: restore the baseline tests (or keep them under a marker) rather than deleting them. Run the A-3D teacher/bank/data tests in the default suite at minimum.

major_issues.issue: cls_T4 is defined as 'argmax of region prob, avg-pooled'. Average-pooling integer labels is undefined.
major_issues.correction: Tokenizer/losses owner: average-pool the teacher softmax probabilities over the stage-4 cell, then take the argmax. Use the same pooled fractions for Q3 so cls_T4 and the Q3 targets stay consistent.

major_issues.issue: codeKD also runs on L frames, but w_pat is defined and cached only for U patients, and the teacher/student intensity augmentation split is specified only for U.

Apply the U intensity rule (teacher clean, student strong) to L codeKD as well. Choose one, record it in the config, and keep it identical across arms.

major_issues.issue: '8000 updates' is ambiguous because of gradient accumulation 2 (one L plus one U per update). The repository requires logical sample updates and optimizer updates to be reported separately.
major_issues.correction: Config/engine owner: define 8000 as optimizer updates or as logical updates, log both counters, and base ramp, warmup, cosine and the evaluation cadence on the declared counter.

minor_or_unspecified.issue: The statistics behind 'per-channel std of F_T_aln' (batch-wise, running, or precomputed) are unspecified.

minor_or_unspecified.issue: The class-coverage gate (>=4 codes per RV/MYO/LV) does not say whether it uses hard or soft assignments, which data, or how 'majority' is defined.
minor_or_unspecified.proposal: Use hard codes on L+U teacher cells: the code's majority class is the argmax of its accumulated teacher class fractions. Lock this before running.

minor_or_unspecified.issue: Checking tau on L ground truth uses annotated ED/ES, while U uses max/min LV volume, so the two are inconsistent. L has only 2 masked frames.
minor_or_unspecified.proposal: Record the difference. tau stays locked after P0, and the diagnostic is NOT_RUN until real data is available.

minor_or_unspecified.issue: The deploy geometry is written as '(spacing_zyx, affine)', but the runtime contract is the exact mapping {shape, spacing_zyx, affine_zyx, context='full_volume'}.

rot90 changes shape and spacing, so geometry, affine and the SDF must all be rebuilt. With z spacing of about 10 mm against R=5 mm, the SDF is effectively in-plane, and the near band in z is empty except within the boundary slice.
minor_or_unspecified.proposal: Recompute the target from the transformed mask with the swapped spacing, and add a test.

minor_or_unspecified.issue: With D about 10, only ceil(D/8)=2 of 4 teacher z cells overlap real slices, so z clamping must use the valid cell count, not the padded count.
minor_or_unspecified.proposal: Clamp to ceil(D/8)-1, as in M1.

independent_interpretations.physical_alignment: Both networks see the same native grid, so no affine is needed. The alignment is a pure index map, but it must use the true receptive-field centers of each layer stack (M1), not assumed box cells. The z axis matters most.
independent_interpretations.padding_invariance: The teacher is not padding-invariant: its valid cells near the end see replicated slices. That is deterministic and acceptable. For the student, see M2: the minimum gate is re-deriving the pad from valid voxels; the strong gate is masked norm and attention plus per-stage re-padding.

verdict: P0_REVIEW_COMPLETE_WITH_BLOCKERS. Real T/Q/J execution is blocked by B1 (no verified pretrained teacher). B2 and B3 are software blockers with clear fixes. No real-data or GPU evidence exists, and none was synthesized.
